claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bremen (Brem), Neynaber, Bremen May 6 and
Southampton 9th, with mdse and 738 passengers, to Oelrichs
& Co. May 9, at 3:45 PM, passed steamship Teutonia (Ham),
16 miles W of Needles, bound E; 13th, 4:30 PM, lat 49 10, lon
25, passed a full rigged steamship of the Inman line, bound
E; 19th, lat 41 41, lon 57 35, passed bark Phebe Dunbar (Br),
bound W; 21st, lat 40 34, lon 70, passed bark Warren White,
bound to Boston.
